harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent, key-only SSH ingestion path from node2 to node1. Each completed connection atomically creates a separate private receipt; arbitrary commands, PTYs, shells, and forwarding are blocked. Existing data, OS releases, and kernels were preserved, and both nodes recovered successfully from individual restarts.
actions_performed: Created separate locked application accounts: non-login uploader on node2 and forced-command ingest on node1.
Generated an ED25519 key on node2 with restricted permissions and pinned node1's host key.
Installed a root-owned atomic receipt handler and authorized the uploader key with OpenSSH restrict and command options.
Verified exact byte preservation using matching source and receipt SHA-256 digests.
Tested arbitrary-command, PTY, shell, and live forwarding attempts; none bypassed the forced handler.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified changed boot identities, system recovery, persisted configuration, data, and post-restart uploads.

evidence.requirement: Separate uploader key and restricted application identity
evidence.summary: Shows the non-login uploader account, protected ED25519 key, matching authorized-key fingerprint, restrict/forced-command policy, and persistence after restart.

evidence.requirement: Submitted bytes are stored as separate receipt files
evidence.summary: Source and receipt bytes match exactly by size and SHA-256; final listing shows distinct mode-0600 receipt files and no incomplete temporary files.

evidence.requirement: No arbitrary commands, shell, PTY, or forwarding
evidence.summary: A malicious command string invoked only the receipt handler, the escape marker remained absent, PTY allocation failed, and a live forwarding channel was rejected as administratively prohibited.

evidence.requirement: Existing receipt and sample batch preserved
evidence.summary: Initial and final bytes, hashes, sizes, ownership, modes, paths, and timestamps match for sample-batch.txt and received/prior.txt.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on CentOS 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64; no software installation or kernel change was performed.

Healthy baseline boot ID d052eb57-c81d-4309-ae7f-bce362073ff9, acknowledged native reboot, observed disconnect, changed boot ID 50db0f24-6cd2-4124-9c61-c9270d0d00f9, recovered SSH/data/policy, and successful byte-verified post-restart upload.

Healthy baseline boot ID df8bab0d-5c09-47a2-a150-4ce12d0f9549, acknowledged native reboot, observed unavailability, changed boot ID c5aecde1-475d-4cba-81d5-ddfe65cdfd5f, restored uploader key/configuration, and successful byte-verified post-restart upload.
